title: Missing slippage protection allows unexpected asset amounts
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `ERC4626` interaction functions in `StakedYuzuUSD`, `YuzuUSD`, and `YuzuILP` lack slippage protection mechanisms.
